run.name: Newell Brands Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (NWL)
run.summary: Earnings are recovering and the 2027 maturity is gone, but leverage is high, cash generation is thin and the 2028 notes are the next test. The credit view is cautious, with leverage reliant on management's EBITDA. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is NEWELL BRANDS INC..

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA before impairment, filing basis (operating income plus D&A plus impairment), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Gross debt 4,673 and net debt 4,470 over management Normalized EBITDA 882 (twelve months to 2025-12-31); debt at carrying value, cash excludes restricted cash; calculated, EBITDA is a management non-GAAP claim.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Management Normalized EBITDA 882 over cash paid for interest 354 (10-K cash flow supplemental line); calculated; on net interest expense of 321 the ratio is 2.75x.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash at 2026-09-30, of which about 174 is held by non-US subsidiaries; ABL net availability as printed: 741 borrowing-base availability less 215 drawn less 46 letters of credit, under an 800 commitment; borrowing-base limited; not a committed amount; receivables factoring is not counted as liquidity.

cashflow.basis: Operating cash flow, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant headroom, ownership, executed agreements and current ratings are not supplied; EBITDA is a management measure that includes tariff recoveries.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is a management measure that includes tariff recoveries; interim cash interest and covenant headroom are not supplied.
